tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the purpose, architecture, and flow of the HR Analytics Data Reporter workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Data Reporter Authentication
tutorials.description: Understand Data Reporter personas and configure Oracle APEX Accounts as the current authentication scheme.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Reporting Views and Application
tutorials.description: Replace the temporary HAA application, create reporting views and a governed dataset, and create the Data Reporter application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Data Reporter Roles and Users
tutorials.description: Create the Data Reporter administrator and assign editor and viewer access to the HR Analytics App.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Build HR Analytics Reports
tutorials.description: Create four HR reports, group-by summaries, charts, facets, and Primary Default settings.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Publish and Review
tutorials.description: Publish every report and validate the completed application as the end-user viewer.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving LiveLabs help.
